description: This PHP class 'DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator' contains methods for managing database permissions, creating and modifying tables, evaluating CRUD operations, handling foreign keys, and testing user privileges within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator
classes.description: A class responsible for evaluating and managing database permissions, creating tables, modifying schema, and testing privileges in the OracleHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the evaluator with a database connection.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the SchemaHelper instance for schema manipulations.

methods.name: evalCreatePermission
methods.description: Creates a test table with various columns and constraints to evaluate creation privileges.

methods.name: evalCrudPermission
methods.description: Performs a series of CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations to test and evaluate the database user's permissions.

methods.name: evalAlterPermission
methods.description: Performs schema alterations such as adding, changing, renaming, and dropping columns to test permission to alter schemas.

methods.name: evalForeignKeyPermission
methods.description: Creates tables with foreign keys, inserts data, and validates foreign key constraints to evaluate foreign key permissions.

methods.name: evalDropPermission
methods.description: Drops tables and disables constraints to test drop and constraint management permissions.

methods.name: evalPrivilegeDatabaseUserPermission
methods.description: Runs the sequence of privilege evaluation methods to comprehensively test database user permissions.
